text: 香港特区政府财政司司长陈茂波11日发表网志表示，香港正全面加强“内联外通”。皇岗口岸将正式启用，这对经常往返港深两地的市民、商务人士和旅客来说十分便利。同时，亚太经合组织（APEC）财政部长会议将在港举行，更凸显国家对香港的厚爱。（新华社）
text_en: Hong Kong Financial Secretary Paul Chan Mo-po published a blog post on the 11th stating that Hong Kong is comprehensively strengthening "internal connectivity and external outreach." The Huanggang Port will officially open, which is very convenient for residents, businesspeople, and travelers who frequently travel between Hong Kong and Shenzhen. At the same time, the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Finance Ministers' Meeting will be held in Hong Kong, further highlighting the country's deep affection for Hong Kong. (Xinhua News Agency)
